Activate Toon World.

Destroy Swords of Revealing Light with Mystical Space Typhoon.
Use Graceful Charity and discard Autonomous Action Unit and Salvage.
Use Legendary Flame Lord's effect.
Special summon Fenrir and go for direct attacks.

Revive Rare Metal Dragon and Kaiser Glider using Premature Burial and Monster Reborn.

Attack Jinzo with Rare Metal Dragon.
Attack Big Koala with Blue-Eyes.
Finally, let Reflect Bounder attack directly.

Now use Monster Reborn to revive Invader of Darkness from your Graveyard.
Revive Spell Canceller with Call of the Haunted.
Attack.
